visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a large heart-shaped multi-layered puff pastry dessert topped with white cream swirls and small round caramelized balls. The background is a clean, dark-toned counter. The scene cuts to two Asian men standing side-by-side in a kitchen setting. The man on the right wears a black jacket over a white shirt and has long hair; the man on the left wears a black chef's uniform with a logo. They transition to shots of a modern shop entrance with a gray sign reading '5.TUNG' and interior views of refrigerated display cases filled with intricate strawberry and pistachio desserts labeled with prices. (2) The host and chef stand behind a blue-topped stainless steel worktable in a bright professional kitchen. A large white industrial dough sheeter machine is prominent. The chef handles a rectangular block of pale yellow dough, sprinkling white flour onto the blue surface. He demonstrates operating the machine, pulling a metal lever to roll out the dough into a thin sheet. Close-up shots focus on his gloved hands as he folds multiple layers of dough, explaining the technical process. The background consists of white tiled walls and stainless steel shelving. (3) The chef begins assembling a heart-shaped dessert. He uses a piping bag to squeeze thick white cream in a serpentine pattern onto three separate heart-shaped layers of caramelized puff pastry. He adds a dark brown salted caramel sauce in a circular motion. He stacks the layers carefully with his hands, then flips the entire structure upright. He pipes more white cream on top and uses tweezers to place seven small, glossy caramel-coated puffs onto the cream peaks. Finally, he adds tiny flecks of gold leaf. (4) The two men are now seated at a round metallic table in a modern interior space. They face the camera directly for a Q&A session. The host gestures frequently while speaking, and the chef responds with a relaxed posture. The background shows a blurry retail or cafe environment. The video concludes with a graphic end screen featuring a black triangle with logo text against a green swirling background, followed by a brand logo animation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, upbeat electronic pop music with a prominent synthesized drum beat starts immediately. A male voice with high arousal and a bright, energetic tone delivers a fast-paced introduction. The recording is studio-clean with minimal ambient noise. Sound effects like a digital 'ding' and a camera shutter 'click' are synchronized with visual transitions. The vocal delivery is clear and professionally projected. (2) The energetic BGM continues as a second male voice enters the mix with a calmer, more instructional tone. Audible sounds of low-frequency friction from dough handling and the mechanical hum of a motor are present. There are sharp, transient 'clicks' from metal levers being moved. Occasional laughter from the host provides high-valence vocal peaks. The music remains at a moderate background level, allowing for clear speech-music overlap. (3) The background music maintains its steady rhythm. There are soft, squishing sound effects accompanying the visual of cream being piped onto the pastry. Short, metallic 'tink' sounds occur. The voices continue a back-and-forth dialogue; the host's tone remains teasing and humorous, while the chef explains technical details with clear articulation. The ambient floor is very low. (4) The acoustic environment shifts slightly to a more open-sounding room with a faint reverb. The BGM remains consistent but lowers in the mix during the Q&A session. Frequent bursts of high-volume laughter from both men dominate the mix. The sounds of hands clapping and light thuds on a metallic table are audible. The video ends with a distinct, short musical stinger and a digital logo pop sound.
